book.name: Hebrews
book.title: HEBREWS Lat Inan Pam Wanch Hebrews Al-Alantan Umpin

content: Nil God.angan Puk Nhengk Nungantam Kuch Wik Min Thamp

Aak keenkanamana nil God.angana wuut mangk ngamparam al-alantan wik many-manyam waaꞌ thant. Nil wikim kuch thanttang, pam prophets nungantam al-alantang, than wikan yipam waaꞌayn pam wanchantan. Wiyiya God.ana pithang thaw thant, puth wiyiya ngaantiyongk wampin thant. Aꞌ ngul-ngulana than wik chil yot ngul waaꞌ-waaꞌin thanta pam wanchantan, nil yimanamana.

Aꞌ aak ngul-ngulana God.angana puk nhengk nungantam anan kuch nunanga wik min thampa, nilan-a, waaꞌ-waaꞌ ngul ngampara. Aak keenkanam anpalmana, nil piip God.an thawa nhengk nungantam alantan aakan yumpow thamp, aak inman umyompanamana putha aak in kenyan, aꞌ putha nil God.an thaw yuk way min aak an kenyana aꞌ putha yuk way min aak inpalana an nungantam thamp puk nhengk ngatharamantam.

Nil nhengk nungantam keꞌ piip God anmana, thonam anman pulaniya, pam piꞌana aꞌ pam minam paththama. Nil nhengk God.antam alangan aak inmana maꞌ thayanang piꞌ-piꞌana. Nil puth uthama aꞌ putha thaaꞌ-pant thawan ngamparam nil God.angan yipam ngangk pachathow ngampang way anpalan aꞌ amanamaniya nil aak keny ngulan mat, pam piꞌan karpam iiyanpul God.anga keꞌ thonam yimanangana.
Nhengk God.antaman Wuut Piꞌan, Ngaantiyongk Anangan Yaꞌa

Nil God.angan pam thonam anman nhengk waaꞌan nunang, nil ngaantiyongk nungantam anangan puk nhengk keꞌam waaꞌan thanang yaꞌ paththam. Nil nhengk nungantamana wuut piꞌan thampa yump nunang — ngaantiyongk anangan yaꞌa.
Nil God.an wik inangan keꞌam thaw thant ngaantiyongk al-alantanweya,

content.text: “Niiy nhengk ngatharama.
Ngay niiyangan miꞌang moom piꞌan iiyān ngatharangana.”

content: Aꞌ putha nil wik inangan keꞌam thaw thamp ngaantiyongk al-alantanweya,

content.text: “Ngayiya piip niiyantam ngul iiyāng,
niiyiya nhengk ngatharam ngula.”

content: Yaꞌa, nil God.an wik yimanangan Christ.antan ep thaw, puth ngaantiyongk al-alantan yaꞌa.
Aꞌ puth inan thampa, nil God.angan puk nhengk nungantam kaaꞌ-thonaman kuch aak iikanakan-a, nilan thaw ngaantiyongk al-alantana,

content.text: “Niiy maꞌmangkaman thuchān nungant aꞌ putha thaaꞌ-kuumpān nunang Christ.ana.”

content: Nil God.angan miꞌ thanang ngaantiyongk anangana workan iiy-iiyayn nungant. Nil thamp thawa:

content.text: “Thananiya keꞌ wunt yimananga,
puth keꞌ thum nganthan pench-penchan yimanang thamp iiy-iiyantan.”

content: Puth nil wik inan thawan nungant puk nhengk nungantam Jesus.antana:

content.text: “Nint keꞌ ngay anmana Goda putha nintana moom piꞌan paththam wun-wunangan ngatharang aak umpuyama.
Aꞌ nint moom min-minam paththam iiy-iiyangan thant pam wanch nungkaramakana.
Aꞌ nintam thonam anman min paththaman iiy-iiyangan,
way anangan nint kaangk keꞌan.
Nintan puth kaangk thathān thanang pam wanch anangan minan iiyayn,
nint kaangk keꞌ-keꞌam paththam thathān thanang wayan iiyayn.
Puth anpalmaniya ngaya piip nungkaram God.angana ngangk min paththam yumpāng nintang, keꞌ pam wiy yimanangan yaꞌa.”

content: Aꞌ nil God.an inan thaman thawa nhengk nungantamak:

content.text: “Ayyang! Lord-ang! Aak keenkanamana, nint aak an kenyana yumpan aꞌ putha aak inmanan yumpan.
Aak inmana putha aak an kenyana ngul wayamowpul puth nintana ep aak umpuyamak wun-wunān.
Putha aak an kenyana aꞌ aak inmanana an keꞌ kulich kath yimanangan ngul wayamowpul,
aꞌ nintana keꞌ kulich way kath yimanangan puyamam ngul theeꞌān pulang.
Puth ngulaniya aak inmana putha aak in kenyana aak nyiingkanam wiy-wiyam weenowpul.
Puth nintana wiy-wiyamana keꞌ yumpin nungkamangan yaꞌa,
an nint anman wun-wunān aak umpuyamakan.”

content: Nil God.an wik yimanangan thaw nhengk nungantamakana.
Aꞌ thon inan, nil God.an keꞌam thaw ngaantiyongk nungantamakana:

content.text: “Niiyaniya moom piꞌan ngatharang iiy-iiyāna
aꞌ ngay ngul maalathāng thanang than niiyangan ngangk-wayangaman kal-kalayn.
Niiyaniya moom karangk paththam iiy-iiyān thanta.”

content: Nil God.ana wik yimanangan ep thaw nhengk nungantamak Jesus.antan.
Puth ngaantiyongk ananganiy-a, thananiya oony min-miniy paththama nil God.angan kuchan thanang maꞌ-aath-aathayn thanang pam wanch anangan nilan kaaꞌ-piichanathow thananga.
